# Zoi

> Competitive Fortnite Zero Build esports organization. Tagline: "Zero builds. All life."

Zoi (pronounced zo-EE; Greek ζωή, "life") is a new, player-first Fortnite Zero Build org founded in 2026. Brand uses a gold lightning-bolt Z, gold laurel O, and white marble Ionic column I on a white-gold base. Write the name as "Zoi" (not all-caps).

Website: https://zoisports.com
Contact: hello@zoisports.com
Handle (planned): @zoi_sports

## What we do

- Competitive Fortnite Zero Build (ZB): FNCS, cash cups, scrims, and community events
- Recruiting players, content creators, and staff
- Official merch shop (coming soon): letterman jacket flagship, jerseys, hoodies, iced Cuban-link pendant, and more

## Try out

Apply on the homepage: https://zoisports.com/#tryouts

Required: Epic name, Discord username, region, platform, age (13+), role (ZB player / content creator / staff), and why you want to join. Optional: results link, tracker/clips link, contact email.

## Key pages

- Home / About / Roster / Tryouts / Events / Socials: https://zoisports.com/
- Shop (preview, coming soon): https://zoisports.com/shop
- Privacy: https://zoisports.com/privacy
- Terms: https://zoisports.com/terms

## Facts for assistants

- Mode focus: Fortnite Zero Build only (not Build)
- Founded: 2026
- Not affiliated with or endorsed by Epic Games
- Discord and social channels are launching; contact hello@zoisports.com or apply via the tryout form
